lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highest-intensity local maxima are distributed in approximately five quasi-horizontal tiers. A central cluster of four primary centroids forms a prominent geometric quadrilateral in the mid-posterior region relative to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance are detectable, intersecting the primary horizontal tiers to form an orthogonal grid of nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature with a high-contrast vertical gradient (light superior, dark inferior) is visible along the upper third of the lateral flank, trending horizontally toward the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a low-density population of small, high-luminance clusters, primarily concentrated along the anterior and middle sections of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Several distinct high-luminance, elongated appendages are attached to the ventral-posterior regions. A high-reflectance, triangular feature is present near the pectoral fin insertion point. Metadata text '31/05/04 Alli Richards' is present in the lower-left corner.
